observations: Rear/side view of a black commuter-style motorcycle parked on wet, moss-covered interlocking tiles.
Side mirror, rear seat, and a rear carrier rack are visible; an orange souvenir/registration plate is attached but text is too small/blurred to read.
No brand, model name, or engine capacity marking is legible anywhere in the photo.
No close-up of the engine, chain, tires, forks, or odometer is provided.
A car wheel is visible in the background, confirming an outdoor compound setting.

claims.evidence: Seller's own text later says 'bought new 6 months ago', a direct contradiction with no photo evidence of purchase date either way.
No receipt, registration date, or dated photo provided.
No video of the bike running, shifting, or braking; static photo cannot show mechanical function.
Visible painted/metal surfaces in photo 0 show no obvious rust, but frame underside, engine block, and chain are not shown.
No way to confirm part originality from a single exterior photo; would need close-ups of engine casing, stickers, and frame numbers.

risks.risk: Engine/mechanical condition (starting, compression, gear shifting) unknown
risks.proof: Short video clip of the bike starting, idling, and shifting through gears
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working, i.e. worst case non-functional

risks.risk: True age and mileage unclear due to contradictory seller statement
risks.proof: Clear photo of odometer/speedometer and purchase receipt or registration papers with date
risks.if_unproven: priced as older/higher-mileage unit despite 'like new' claim

risks.risk: Model/engine size unknown, which strongly affects resale value in Abuja market
risks.proof: Close-up photo of brand badge, engine casing markings, or chassis/VIN plate
risks.if_unproven: priced at the low end for an unidentified small commuter bike

risks.risk: Hidden rust or frame damage not visible from this single rear angle
risks.proof: Photos of underside, forks, chain, and both side panels in daylight

risks.risk: Registration/plate legitimacy (orange plate appears temporary/souvenir, not a standard LASG/FCT plate)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the actual number plate and vehicle particulars/registration papers
risks.if_unproven: priced as unregistered or with unresolved paperwork risk

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the brand/model badge or engine casing to identify make and engine size
Clear photo of the number plate and registration papers
Short video of the bike starting and running through gears
Photos of underside, chain, and both side panels in good light
response.reason: The brand/model and engine size that set the price bracket for a motorcycle cannot be read from the single rear-angle photo, and the seller's own statement about age is self-contradictory, so no reliable worst-case price can be set without further images.
